text: Survey 2026-10-19 (Opus) + user decision. Plan: (1) image4s-locus GridComponents (D3, Face/FaceEdge/FaceEdgeCorner, components ordered by smallest member ordinal) with shared JVM/JS tests; consumer latent/RadialBasis (delete its private connectedComponents). (2) Delete duplicates/dead: image MaskedLocalStats+FieldValidity (copies of reframe4s halfflow internals; ScalaFIM copy has x-fastest latent bug), unused ClusterSearchlightTypes members, SpatialDimSize/AxisCode if unused, spatial DiscreteTransport, SelectedImage forwarders (fit:ImageMaps calls image4s SelectedSampled directly). (3) VolumeNeighborhoods -> locus4s CenteredNeighborhoodSystem (ids via centerEmbedding ordinal). (4) GaleSpatialSupport -> Gale gatherRows/toCOO/applyTo (keep nonEmpty checks). User decision: neuroim2-parity APIs with no production consumer (KMeans, SpatialFilters/Kernel3D, Ops/NeuroStats, ParcelNeighborhoods, image ConnectedComponents wrapper ~2.3k LOC) MOVE UNCHANGED to neuroim4s with eco-neuroim-core, not deleted. SpatialFilters are NOT equivalent to image4s Gaussian (support/border/summation) — never 'migrate' them. Deferred to spatial split: SpatialGraph routing, RowSelection. PrimitiveBuffers inlining -> simplification phase A.
